title: backblaze b2 large file endless loop
body:
Trying to transfer 100 gb file, speed is fine but it has no chance to complete. Infinite exponential backoff on error 500/503 maybe?
Also minimum sleep timer probably should be 5sec, and timeout 5min, backblaze is SLOW.

> What is your rclone version (eg output from `rclone -V`)
> rclone v1.32
> 
> Which OS you are using and how many bits (eg Windows 7, 64 bit)
> Win10 64bit
> 
> Which cloud storage system are you using? (eg Google Drive)
> Backblaze B2
> 
> The command you were trying to run (eg `rclone copy /tmp remote:tmp`)
> rclone copy -v archive.rar b2:wizzard/containers
> 
> A log from the command with the `-v` flag (eg output from `rclone -v copy /tmp remote:tmp`)
